messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 17 May
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 17 May from 07:00 to 11:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and check in any open documents before Friday close. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
